# FIX Restoration

> 24/7 restoration services in American Fork, UT.

FIX Restoration (FIX Restoration) is a professional restoration contractor serving American Fork, UT and surrounding areas since 2012. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (801) 930-9750 · Email: scott.noland@gofloodpros.com.
